==========
CREW ALERT
==========

SB007/14                               VALID: 12-OCT-14 0330 - UFN
  SB007/14 COMPANY NOTAM
  WHEN PLANNING A COST INDEX, 2 OPTIONS ARE AVAILABLE. PILOTS MAY
  EITHER SELECT A SPECIFIC COST INDEX NUMBER FROM THE LIST, OR THEY
  MAY SELECT "AUTO". WHEN PLANNING AN "AUTO" COST INDEX, THE SYSTEM
  WILL REFERENCE THE SCHEDULED "TIME ENROUTE" OPTION AND ATTEMPT TO
  CHOOSE A COST INDEX WHICH CLOSELY MATCHES THIS VALUE. NOTE THAT
  THE "TIME ENROUTE" OPTION IS MEANT AS A GATE TO GATE TIME (AS
  INDICATED ON AN AIRLINE'S FLIGHT SCHEDULE, FOR EXAMPLE). IF A
  "TIME ENROUTE" OF 2:30 IS SELECTED, THE SYSTEM WILL SUBTRACT THE
  TAXI TIMES FROM THIS VALUE TO DETERMINE THE SCHEDULED AIR TIME. IT
  WILL THEN DETERMINE AND USE THE COST INDEX WHICH MATCHES THIS AIR
  TIME.

SB003/13                               VALID: 13-JUL-13 0320 - UFN
  SB003/13 COMPANY NOTAM
  ALL FLIGHT CREW: PLEASE PAY SPECIAL ATTENTION TO THE UNITS
  SELECTION WHEN GENERATING A FLIGHT PLAN. FAILURE TO IDENTIFY THE
  CORRECT UNITS WHEN REFUELING PRIOR TO FLIGHT CAN RESULT IN
  DEPARTING WITH INSUFFICIENT FUEL AND/OR AN ERRONEOUS PAYLOAD.

  JORDAN, QATAR,   OMAN, UAE AND SAUDI ARABIA.  3. ENSURE THAT AN

A0350/26                               VALID: 08-APR-26 0901 - UFN
  UKRAINIAN CRISIS:
  IT SHALL BE PROHIBITED FOR ANY ACFT OPERATED BY RUSSIAN AIR
  CARRIERS, OR FOR ANY RUSSIAN REGISTERED ACFT, OR FOR ANY NON-
  RUSSIAN-REGISTERED ACFT WHICH IS OWNED OR CHARTERED, OR OTHERWISE
  CONTROLLED BY ANY RUSSIAN NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSON, ENTITY OR BODY,
  TO LAND IN, TAKE-OFF FROM OR OVERFLY THE TERRITORY OF THE REPUBLIC
  OF BULGARIA.
  THE PROHIBITITION SHALL NOT APPLY IN THE CASE OF AN EMERGENCY
  LANDING OR AN EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT AND TO ACFT THAT HAVE A MAXIMUM
  SEATING CAPACITY OF 4 PERSONS AND A MAXIMUM TAKE-OFF MASS OF NO
  MORE THAN 2000KG WHEN USED FOR PRIVATE, NON-CORPORATE, FLIGHTS FOR
  RECREATIONAL PURPOSES OR FOR THE PURPOSE OF TRAINING FOR PRIVATE
  PILOT LICENSES AND RELATED RATINGS WITH UNION TRAINING PROVIDERS.

A2172/26                    VALID: 22-MAY-26 0500 - 02-JUN-26 0900
  NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:  THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO
  CLARIFY THE 'A1636/26' NOTAM ISSUED BY GREEK CAA. THE
  UNPRECEDENTED AND DEFIANT PRACTICE OF GREECE IN DEFINING 6  NM
  WIDE TERRITORIAL WATERS AND 10 NM NATIONAL AIRSPACE CONTRADICTS 
  WITH THE INTERNATIONAL LAW AND CONSEQUENTLY VIOLATES THE RIGHT OF 
  FREE USE OF INTERNATIONAL AIRSPACE. ACCORDING TO INTERNATIONAL LAW
   THE AIRSPACE OVER WHICH A STATE CAN CLAIM COMPETENCE AND
  EXCLUSIVE  SOVEREIGNITY IS LIMITED TO THAT PORTION WHICH LIES
  ABOVE ITS  TERRITORY AND THE TERRITORIAL WATERS ADJACENT TO IT.
  THEREFORE, THIS  ILLEGAL PRACTICE OF GREECE IS INVALID AND
  UNACCEPTABLE TO TURKIYE.

A1429/26                    VALID: 13-MAY-26 1600 - 10-JUN-26 1559
  AIRCRAFT OPERATING ON THE THE FOLLOWING ROUTES SHALL ADHERE TO 
  THE SPECIAL EMERGENCY DESCENT PROCEDURE.  1.APPLICABLE ROUTES 
  ROUTE W277, SEGMENT MUMOD-VARSO  ROUTE W45, SEGMENT SADET-ATMIL 
  ROUTE W276, SEGMENT ATMIL-BOVKI  ROUTE B215, SEGMENT ADBES-AGVUR 
  ROUTE W287, SEGMENT AGVUR-MENED  ROUTE G212, SEGMENT WJC-TONOV 
  2.SPECIAL PROCEDURE FOR EMERGENCY DESCENT  2.1 IN AN EMERGENCY
  SITUATION THAT THREATENS FLIGHT SAFETY, THE  PIC(PILOT IN COMMAND)
  HAS THE RIGHT TO CHANGE THE ORIGINALLY  ASSIGNED FLIGHT LEVEL, BUT
  SHALL IMMEDIATELY REPORT TO THE ATC AND  WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR
  THE ACTION TAKEN.THE SPECIAL PROCEDURE FOR  EMERGENCY DESCENT
  SHALL BE: TURN RIGHT 30 DEGREES FROM THE  AIRCRAFT'S CURRENT
  FLIGHT TRACK, MAINTAIN THE HEADING TO ESTABLISH  A 5NM (9.3KM)
  OFFSET, THEN DESCEND TO THE NEW FLIGHT LEVEL AND  TURN BACK TO THE
  ORIGINAL ROUTE BY ATC.  2.2 IF THE AIRCRAFT IS UNABLE TO COMPLY
  WITH THE ABOVE  REQUIREMENTS, THE PIC SHALL ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH
  ATC AS SOON AS  POSSIBLE AND   )  // // STATE THE INTENTION.  2.3
  ONCE THE SAFETY THREAT HAS BEEN RESOLVED, THE PIC SHALL ADVISE 
  ATC PROMPTLY IF REQUIRING RADAR VECTORS TO REJOIN THE ORIGINAL 
  ROUTE. ATC SHALL CONTINUE TO PROVIDE AIR TRAFFIC SERVICES 
  CONSIDERING CURRENT TRAFFIC FLOW, AIRSPACE STRUCTURE, 
  METEOROLOGICAL CONDITIONS AND OTHER AIRSPACE USER ACTIVITIES.   ) 
  // //
